{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("Sample of QA orders:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue_clean']])"}
